title: Shops

{{Infobox/Generic |image=Jacobus.png }} '''Shops''' are [[NPC]]s or areas in [[SkyBlock]] which sell items for a fixed price to the player. == Mechanics == === Buying === {{/Buying}} ==== Discounting ==== {{stub|variant=section|Should have full list}} Buying items can be discounted in multiple ways, including [[Accessories]] like {{Item|Seal of the Family}} or [[Attributes]] like {{Attr|Bartender Discount}}. === Selling === Players can sell items to '''Shops''' for {{Coins}}. All merchants accept all sellable items at the same price. Some items may not be able to be sold. Player's are limited to only selling up to {{Coins|500m}} per day, which resets at 00:00 [[w:UTC+0|UTC+0]]. == Merchants == {{Outdated|section=y|[[NPC]]s moved with the Hub Revamp, Torrhus Canyon, etc.}} === Village === These are the merchants found in the [[Village]]. {| class="wikitable" width="100%" !
